name: md-notebook
description: Keep a portable, versioned Markdown notebook in Git. Clone a GitHub repo or use an existing folder or Obsidian vault in place. Edit rendered notes, follow [[wikilinks]] and backlinks, and commit, pull, and push in one sync. Merge conflicts list affected notes and abort without overwriting them.
author: kirocrew
highlights: Your notes are plain markdown in a git repo — no lock-in, readable by Obsidian or any editor
Clone a GitHub repo as a vault, or attach a folder you already have without copying it
Click any rendered block to edit it in place; Enter starts a new block, Tab nests lists
[[Wikilinks]] between notes, with a backlinks list showing what points at the note you are reading
Full-text search across titles and content, plus folder and flat views with six sort orders
One-step sync commits, pulls and pushes; a merge conflict lists the conflicted notes and overwrites nothing
A save is refused if the file changed on disk since you opened it, so edits made elsewhere are never clobbered
Optionally index a vault into the Knowledge library so agents can search your notes
useCases: Edit a portable Markdown vault with wikilinks, backlinks, search, Git history, and optional Knowledge indexing.
configuration: Clone a Git repository or attach an existing local folder, then optionally enable Knowledge and scheduled sync; private GitHub clones need a PAT or authenticated gh.
